svg.aria-label: Constructed hypothetical composite, seed 710, mass 5 mg, heating rate 10 °C/min and polymer mass fraction 0.8. Endothermic is upward. A retains specific-heat background; B fits the glass-step midpoint; C marks integration regions; D distinguishes normalization bases.
